tools.name: AggregateComponentActions
tools.description:
Get how a Figma library's components were inserted and detached, week by week.

Detachments are the signal that a component is not serving its consumers. Requires a
Figma Enterprise organization.

parameters.name: file_key
parameters.description: Key of the library file. Can be found in Figma URL: https://www.figma.com/file/{FILE_KEY}/...

parameters.name: group_by
parameters.description: Whether to return one row per component or one row per acting team, per week. Defaults to ASSET.

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: Earliest week to include, as YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to no lower bound.

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: Latest week to include, as YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to no upper bound.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The next_cursor from a previous call, to fetch the next page. Defaults to the first page.

tools.name: CreateComment
tools.description:
Add a comment to a Figma file or reply to an existing comment.

If parent_comment_id is provided, creates a reply to that comment.
Otherwise creates a new comment (optionally attached to a node).

parameters.name: file_key
parameters.description: File key. Can be found in Figma URL: https://www.figma.com/file/{FILE_KEY}/...

parameters.name: message
parameters.description: The comment or reply text.

parameters.name: parent_comment_id
parameters.description: Parent comment ID to reply to. If provided, creates a reply. Defaults to a new top-level comment.

parameters.name: node_id
parameters.description: Node ID to attach the comment to. Ignored for replies. Defaults to a comment on the whole file.

parameters.name: x
parameters.description: X position offset on the node. Only used with node_id. Defaults to 0.

parameters.name: y
parameters.description: Y position offset on the node. Only used with node_id. Defaults to 0.

A link cannot be moved to a different node. Delete it and attach a new one instead.

parameters.description: Identifier of the link to update.

parameters.description: New display name. Providing this renames the link. Defaults to leaving the name unchanged.

tools.name: UpdateVariables
tools.description:
Create, update, and delete Figma variables, collections, and modes in one call.

Figma applies the whole batch or none of it. Entities created in the same call can
reference each other by the temporary ids you supply, and the response maps each of
those to the real id Figma assigned. Deleting a variable is permanent.

Requires a Figma Enterprise organization.

parameters.name: file_key
parameters.description: File key. Can be found in Figma URL: https://www.figma.com/file/{FILE_KEY}/...

parameters.name: variable_collections
parameters.description: Collections to create, update, or delete. Defaults to leaving collections unchanged.

parameters.name: variable_modes
parameters.description: Modes to create, update, or delete. Defaults to leaving modes unchanged.

parameters.name: variables
parameters.description: Variables to create, update, or delete. Defaults to leaving variables unchanged.

parameters.name: variable_values
parameters.description: Values to set per variable per mode. Defaults to leaving values unchanged.

output.description: Confirmation, and ids assigned to created entities

<Callout type="warning" title="Private OAuth app requirement">
The `projects:read` scope is **ONLY available in private Figma OAuth apps**. This scope is required for the navigation tools (`GetTeamProjects` and `GetProjectFiles`). 
If you need these navigation tools, you must create a private OAuth app through your Figma organization settings. All other tools work with public OAuth apps.
</Callout>

summary:
## Figma Toolkit

The Figma toolkit lets LLMs interact with Figma via the Figma REST API, enabling reading and writing of design files, components, styles, variables, comments, dev resources, and analytics.

## Capabilities

- **File & node inspection** — retrieve full file trees, individual pages, specific nodes (with optional raw paint/style data), version history, and file metadata across all Figma editor types.
- **Library & design token management** — list and inspect published components, component sets, styles, and variables (local and published); create, update, and delete variables, collections, and modes in batch (Enterprise only).
- **Usage analytics** — aggregate weekly action trends and current usage breadth for components, styles, and variables across files and teams; identify blast radius of token changes (Enterprise only).
- **Collaboration** — create, reply to, delete, and list comments; add and remove emoji reactions on comment threads.
- **Dev resource management** — attach, list, update, and delete links from design nodes to code, tickets, or external documents.
- **Export & identity** — export frames/nodes as images (URLs valid ~14 days); resolve the authenticated user's profile.

## OAuth

This toolkit uses OAuth 2.0 with Figma as the provider. See the [Arcade Figma auth provider docs](https://docs.arcade.dev/en/references/auth-providers/figma) for setup details.
